description: This file defines enumerations and data structures related to location commands and payloads for the OpenClaw Kit, including commands to fetch location, accuracy levels, and payload details such as coordinates, accuracy, altitude, speed, heading, timestamp, and source information.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializers for structs, including default and parameterized initializers for `OpenClawLocationGetParams` and `OpenClawLocationPayload`.
